name: Spotify Play Count Scraper → daily rows (Apify, publicrecords)

nodes.name: Run Spotify Play Count Scraper on Apify
nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: name = Authorization, value = Bearer <your Apify API token> (console.apify.com/settings/integrations). Runs bill to your own Apify account at the Store price.

parameters.content:
## Spotify Play Count Scraper
Play counts for every track on a Spotify track, album, artist or playlist link, plus monthly listeners.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/spotify-play-count-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/spotify-play-count-scraper

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
